title: Mock Identity Provider Hermetic Mode
description: Draft provider-mode instance for mock identity provider use as hermetic proof only. This mode can support behaviour-proven hermetic evidence for the authentication slice, but it never satisfies live-external-provider, external-sandbox, production-shaped, or production-live claims by naming or environment implication.
aiGuidance: Mock identity provider evidence is valid hermetic proof only. Do not upgrade it to live-external-provider, external-sandbox, production-shaped, or production-live evidence from environment name, route name, generated report status, or source resemblance.
